text:
alex: Quick roll call — Tuesday marketplace activation is green from infra but we need signoffs on: partner onboarding links, press embargo time, and SI hotline coverage. Anyone missing items?

maya: I'm missing the final partner SSO docs (last I saw was v0.9). Can we lock v1 now?

chris: SSO v1 pushed to the partner bucket: s3://rwd-marketplace/partners/SSO-v1.zip. Confirmed with infra that token exchange example is included.

alex: Thanks. @maya can you review the sample user flow by EOD so we can distribute to pilots?

maya: On it. Also need to confirm if partners get sandbox billing credits automatically or via manual claim link.

danielle: Product note — sandbox grants are manual for now. We have a claim link that auto-provisions a dedicated test tenant for partners. I'll post the final URL here after I confirm with billing.

samir: For PR/press — what's our embargo time? Legal asked for a 24-hour heads-up window, marketing prefers midnight PST on Tuesday. We should pick one.

alex: Proposal: embargo lifts 00:00 PST Tuesday. That gives partners early access Monday afternoon for final checks. @press_bot can you confirm the PR distribution list?

press_bot: PR list: press@redwood-inference.com + top-tier outlets (TechCrunch, VentureBeat, TheRegister). Press kit is at https://storage.redwood/press/marketplace-kit.zip. Embargo set to 2026-04-14T00:00:00-08:00 per requested time.

chris: Landing page snippets pushed to staging tag stg-market-20260413. QA found a CTA link mismatch (checkout vs catalog). Will patch now.

danielle: FYI — the blog draft is in Google Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/marketplace-blog-draft. Marketing wants final by Monday noon for translations.

maya: Translation note — we need to avoid idioms in the hero copy. I'll add localization flags to the doc.

samir: Also need a short partner quote for the announcement. Can @chris loop in Partner A to get a 1-2 sentence blurb?

chris: Reached out earlier. They committed to a quote by EOD tomorrow.

alex: Ops question: who is on the SI hotline during cutover (T+0 to T+6)? We'll route partner emergency requests there.

ops_bot: SI-hotline rota published: Week-of-launch: @danielle (lead), @samir (backup), @chris (fallback). Zoom: https://zoom.redwood/si-hotline. Pager duty contact added for infra escalations.

danielle: I'll stand up the standby channel #si-hotline and invite partner PMs. Also will prepare a short troubleshooting playbook (login, entitlement, catalog visibility, billing).

maya: Playbook checklist idea: 1) verify SSO, 2) confirm entitlement flag, 3) check catalog webhook logs, 4) escalate to infra. I'll write it as a 1-page doc.

alex: Good. On the catalog webhook logs — @chris where will partners check delivery status?

chris: Partners can query /webhooks/status in their console and there's a mirror in the partner dashboard under Integrations > Webhooks. Example curl to check:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <PARTNER_KEY>" https://api.redwood.example/partner/webhooks/status
```

chris: Response returns JSON with latest delivery and retry count. We've added a 48-hour retry policy.

samir: For analytics/tracking — marketing needs UTM scheme for partner links. Use utm_source=partner-catalog&utm_medium=listing&utm_campaign=marketplace-apr2026. Can we bake that into the landing redirect?

chris: Yes, we'll append UTM at redirect level for partner tiles. I'll coordinate with frontend.

alex: One last thing — rollback signal. If we see partner ingress errors >5% or catalog sync failures >10% in the first hour, we automatically flip to the static landing page and delay partner access. Who triggers rollback?

ops_bot: Rollback play: 1) oncall infra triggers static redirect (ops runbook step 3), 2) notify partners and customers, 3) schedule hotfix. Playbook link: https://confluence.redwood/marketplace-rollbacks.

danielle: I'll prepare the partner notification template. Keep language clear and provide ETA window.

samir: PR logistics — post embargo we publish the blog, update landing page, and send partner note. Marketing will send to the list and partners will be notified via the claim link.

maya: Coming back to SSO v1 — tested the token exchange with Partner B and saw one edge case: user name length >64 chars breaks the LDAP mapping. I'll add a validation rule server-side and push a patch in stg.

chris: Noted. We'll deploy the validation rule with blue/green to avoid login disruptions.

alex: Thanks all. Action items recap (short):
- @maya: review user flow + add localization flags + SSO edge-case fix (EOD)
- @danielle: publish claim link + standby channel + partner notification template (tomorrow AM)
- @chris: patch CTA, webhook status curl example, append UTMs (tomorrow)
- @samir: finalize embargo window with legal and publish PR list (today)
- @press_bot/@ops_bot: keep assets and runbook links up-to-date

alex: If everyone repeats thumbs-up in thread we'll call this green. :thumbsup:

maya: 👍

chris: 👍

danielle: 👍

samir: 👍

press_bot: assets confirmed, standing by. :white_check_mark:

ops_bot: rota confirmed, oncall ready. :phone:

alex: Great — closing this check-in. If anything changes ping #launch-alerts and update the playbook link.
